content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR NBPGR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the ICAR-National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources (ICAR NBPGR), Hyderabad, for project-based research positions.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in ICAR NBPGR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Field Assistant, with a total of 3 vacancies announced under the project.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 15 October 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via email. Candidates need to send their applications along with scanned documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The salary for Senior Research Fellow is ₹37,000 + HRA per month for the 1st and 2nd year, and ₹42,000 + HRA per month for the 3rd year.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, or Life Sciences from a recognized university in India.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for ICAR NBPGR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any of the advertised posts, making it free to apply.

faq.question: Q8. What is the upper age limit for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow post is 35 years, with standard relaxations provided for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening of applications followed by a virtual interview conducted by the selection committee.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates send their completed applications?
faq.answer: Candidates should send their complete application package in a single PDF file through email to [email protected].
